payload.claim: The Context section's quoted fragment "Core compares a location with 'the lines the diff changes, never a hunk's context'" doesn't appear verbatim in DESIGN.md. The real text at DESIGN.md:920 is "Core compares the file with the diff's paths and the lines with the lines the diff changes. A hunk's context counts only beside a removed line, where it is the nearest line left" — compatible with the spec's actual mechanism once read carefully, but presented as an exact quotation it is not.
